scope: Report-local inert worker-component collector for the discovery/AEEP two-role comparison; not run and not evidence of completed B execution.

contract.common_inventory: Exactly {spreadsheets_bundle: digest(SharedSpreadsheetsDefinition)}; no historical codex/runtime inventory keys are copied.
contract.physical_support: Both roles require the same immutable image, canonical /opt/dependencies/plugin/skills/spreadsheets/SKILL.md hash, runtime path, pandas/openpyxl versions, and exact enabled supporting-skill/tool inventory. Supporting skills are restricted to the reviewed Spreadsheets alias name at the canonical /opt path; supporting tools are empty and native_catalog is false.
contract.filesystem_alias: The worker CHECK probe independently requires /etc/codex/skills/spreadsheets/SKILL.md to exist and resolve to the canonical /opt skill. The /etc alias is not a configured supporting path or reviewed_files entry; current isolated_config requires reviewed worker-file lookup and does not support that path as a configured skill.
contract.dynamic_difference: The collector uses dynamic_candidate_access_observation with each exact reviewed binding and declaration. Effective role inventory is the reviewed common Spreadsheets descriptor plus the observed callback binding inventory; only the treatment adds the exact candidate tool. Declaration evidence does not claim model exposure or use.
contract.dependencies: The two existing Spreadsheets helper probes must pass in each role and measured physical observations must match across the shared immutable image. Their dependency metadata is not independently hash-pinned by this collector.
contract.output: Per-role worker inspection records and supporting boundary probes only. It strips any nested full_conformance item and does not construct BoundaryConformance, qualification, admission, or value results.

review_findings.finding: Configured skill path must be canonical /opt because isolated_config validates it against immutable reviewed_files; the /etc alias is only an independently observed symlink resolving to the canonical skill.
Common inventory is constrained to the Spreadsheets descriptor digest, and actual support inventory is checked against each role's reviewed profile and worker observations.

Dependency package metadata is compared between roles on the same exact image and the existing behavior probes must pass; the collector makes no claim that dependency hashes are independently reviewed pins.

historical_context.observation_limit: The retained assembly describes a static invocation skill_path at the canonical /opt path and its reviewed_files hash. It is not an actual enabled-catalog runtime observation and is not reused as one.

pending_source_checks: Normal-role support requirements must be compared according to the reviewed three-way contract, not forced equal to discovery/AEEP support inventories.
The candidate worker must be validated against the normal worker as required by the reviewed three-way identity contract.

not_performed: No imports, pytest, lint, model calls, worker starts, Docker commands, network, credentials, grants, or canonical database mutations.
No B trial execution, full conformance assembly, qualification, or admission.
